verdict.rationale: Gitea's own docs say Gitea Actions is compatible with GitHub Actions in both workflow and action syntax. They also say users can reuse thousands of existing GitHub Actions, with actions downloadable from any Git website, which directly covers reusing another platform's workflows and community actions without rewriting. The evidence is brief marketing-level documentation, though. missing for 10: detailed documentation of compatibility scope and known unsupported features, independent or hands-on corroboration that existing GitHub workflows run unmodified.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can reuse existing workflow definitions and community actions written for another platform's CI system without rewriting them

citations.quote: Gitea Actions supports CI/CD functionality, compatible with GitHub Actions. Users can write workflows in familiar YAML format and reuse a variety of existing Actions plugins.
Reuse thousands of existing GitHub Actions inside your Gitea instances.
Workflow and action syntax is compatible with GitHub Actions.
Actions plugins support downloading from any Git website.
